component_missing_value_rule: All four components must be available; no stock-level imputation is allowed.
post_combination_treatment: MAD winsorization, CITIC 2019 level-1 industry neutralization, log-market-cap neutralization, z-score.
return_label: T+1 open to T+21 open, 20 trading-day holding return.
anti_overfitting_rule: No component weights, components, or out-of-sample dates are changed after observing results.
